 Andhra Pradesh KMP Patnaik 2 Nov 2026 10:34 PM IST 2 Nov 2026 10:34 PM IST Thick smoke was seen billowing over nearby neighbourhoods, while multiple fire tenders were rushed to the site to bring the blaze under control.
 x Thick smoke oozes out after a fire accident at the HPCL Visakha refinery on in Visakhapatnam Monday evening. (Photo by Arrangement) As Preferred
Source VISAKHAPATNAM: A fire broke out at the sulphur pitch of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited’s (HPCL) Visakh Refinery at Malkapuram at around 10.15 pm on Monday. No casualties or injuries were reported.
 Preliminary reports suggested that an overhead electrical line might have triggered the fire. Cooling operations were taken up, while the extent of the damage was yet to be assessed. 
 Deputy inspector of factories V. Suresh said five HPCL fire tenders had been deployed to contain the fire. Though it had been brought under control, smoke was still billowing from the pitch, causing concern among employees and the public, he said. 
 Regional fire officer Niranjan Reddy said fires were still burning at two locations, and fire tenders were using foam to extinguish them. 
 The incident caused panic among employees after videos of the fire circulated on social media. Employees were evacuated as a precautionary measure. They had heard a blast before the fire broke out, Niranjan Reddy said.
